The '''ruby circlet''' is a piece of [[jewelry]] that makes the wearer immune to fire. Worn in the head slot, it gives permanent {{MCW|Fire Resistance}}, which makes it a natural companion for trips to [[Hell]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
The [[Jeweler]] sells the ruby circlet at Apprentice level for 4 [[Obol]]s and one [[Ruby]]. The trade can be used 999 times.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/2/ruby_circlet.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Effect ===
While worn by a player, the ruby circlet gives Fire Resistance, reapplied every tick for 1 second with no particles. The effect wears off within a second of the circlet being taken off.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/fire_proof.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Armor ===
The ruby circlet is worn in the head slot and takes the place of a helmet. It gives 1 [[armor]] point and no armor toughness or knockback resistance. Like all jewelry, it is unbreakable and, being built on a netherite helmet, doesn't burn in fire or lava. See [[Jewelry]].
